Title: An Anarch Manifesto + Grey Thorne/Vivienne Géroux

Messages.Author: tsabo
Messages.Body:
Grey Thorne and Vivienne Géroux may play cards requiring certain disciplines as an Anarch vampire. Can they benefit from the +1 stealth on actions requiring an Anarch while equipped with An Anarch Manifesto?

National Coordinator & Prince of Singapore

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body:
I think they can't. They do not change into anarchs, they just can play some card as one. Anarch Manifest requires an anarch vampire.
EDIT: No, Anarch Manifest doesn't require an anarch vampire. The rest is still valid, though.

No it doesn't.

Name: Anarch Manifesto, An
[TR:C]
Cardtype: Equipment
Equipment.
The anarch with this equipment gets +1 stealth on actions that require an anarch.
Titled non-Anarch vampires get +1 strength in combat with this minion. A minion may have only one Anarch Manifesto.
Artist: Heather Kreiter

Smoking craters tell no tales.

Thanks, I've edited my answer. The first sentence was the one that mattered. Anarch Manifesto doesn't require an Anarch, and doesn't grant stealth to a minion who poses as an Anarch to perform actions.
The "Titled non-Anarch vampires get +1 strength in combat with this minion" still applies though.
